title: Show bed: tension
description: A muted 3-3-2 pulse, low strings with an E-flat neighbour, a half-time kit with ticking hats; the motif slow on soft vibes at D5 every 8 bars.
usage: The motif version: for intros, outros and gaps between lines. Under speech prefer the -underscore version. Loops seamlessly (sample 0 to the end). -26 LUFS-S with a voice pocket at 1.25-2 kHz: duck it under Zoo's narration with scripts/audio/duck.py (the band-split duck, its default). Same tempo and key family as the other show beds: cross-fade between them on a bar line (every 2.667 s).
selfReview: D minor with phrygian edges: a muted 3-3-2 pulse, low strings with an Eb neighbour, a half-time kit with ticking hats; the motif slow on soft vibes at D5. Critic round 1 (2026-11-24): the pulse sat in Zoo's F0 and second-harmonic range (98-156 Hz) and the motif on low piano at D3+D2. The pulse is now two octaves over the bass (196-311 Hz), low-passed at 1.5 kHz and 3 dB down; the motif moved to D5 and is absent from the underscore; the EP re-voices every 4 bars and the bass walks into each phrase (it repeated bar for bar); every kick is tuned to the bass (it beat against the B-flat and G roots); hats and the kick's beater are quieter and the bus takes 2.5 dB off below 150 Hz. With the band-split duck its index is 0.78-0.79 (0.71 before with the broadband duck; speech-shaped noise 0.69); the onsets that reach within 15 dB of his voice in 1-4 kHz are back to the first build's rate (30-35 a minute) and it loses 5.9 LU on the phone model, as before. The -underscore version mutes the motif and lead lines; use it under speech.
